Web Design Service

Professional Web Design Services for Businesses Across the USA

Your website should do more than look good. It should clearly represent your business, work smoothly on every device, load properly, and make it easy for potential customers to contact you.

We provide professional website design and web development services for small businesses, growing companies, and organizations across the United States. Whether you need a brand-new website, a WordPress site, a redesign, or help improving an outdated online presence, our team can help you build a website designed around your business goals.

From planning and page structure to responsive design and launch, we handle the technical details so you can focus on running your business.

Live in 7 Days | SEO-Optimized | Responsive Design | No Hidden Charges

Get a Free Consultation

Tell us about your business and what you need from your website. We will discuss your goals and help you determine the right approach for your project.

Book a Consultation Now

Since 2013

Website repair & SEO recovery experience

1,000+ Websites

Repaired across multiple industries

24/7 Support

Emergency help — call or text anytime

Since 2013

Houston-based, serving clients nationwide

Web Design That Works for Your Business

A website is often one of the first places potential customers learn about your business. If the site looks outdated, is difficult to navigate, or does not work properly on mobile devices, visitors may leave before learning what you offer.

Our web design services focus on the essentials that matter to both your business and your visitors. We create clean, professional websites with clear navigation, responsive layouts, organized content, and strong calls to action.

Every project begins by understanding your business. We look at what you do, who you want to reach, what information your customers need, and what actions you want visitors to take.

Our goal is straightforward: create a website that represents your business professionally and gives customers a clear path to contact you, request a service, or learn more.

How We Work

Our process is clear, efficient, and built around your needs

01

Free Consultation

We start by reviewing your site and identifying the problems — whether it’s SEO, loading speed, DNS errors, or broken features.

02

Live Diagnosis

We schedule a live session (via phone, Zoom, or Google Meet) to walk you through the issues and explain what needs fixing.

03

Secure Backup

Before making any changes, we take a complete backup of your site to ensure your data is protected.

04

Fast Repairs

Most issues are resolved within 1–3 business days. We fix, test, and verify every change for full functionality.

05

Ongoing Support

After the job is done, we offer guidance, reports, and optional ongoing support to keep your site running strong.

Why Choose Our Website Design Company?

Choosing a website design company is about more than finding someone who can put pages together. Your website needs proper planning, reliable development, responsive functionality, and a structure that can support your business as it grows.

We Start With Your Business Goals

Before development begins, we discuss your services, target audience, website requirements, and priorities. This helps us build the right structure instead of using a one-size-fits-all approach.

Responsive Website Design

More people browse websites from mobile devices than ever before. Our responsive website design approach helps ensure that your pages remain easy to use across different screen sizes.

Built With Search in Mind

A visually attractive website alone is not enough. We organize pages and content with a clean, search-friendly structure that supports future SEO work.

WordPress and Modern Website Solutions

Need a website you can manage after launch? We provide WordPress web design and other website development solutions based on your business needs and technical requirements.

Support Beyond Launch

Your website may need updates, fixes, maintenance, or additional pages over time. As a website support and development team, we can continue helping after your site goes live.

What Is Included in Our Professional Website Design?

Our website projects can include the essential components needed to create a professional online presence.

Responsive Layout

Your website is developed to adapt across desktop, tablet, and mobile screens.

Modern Page Design

We create organized page layouts that make important information easier for visitors to find.

Business-Focused Content Structure

From homepages and service pages to contact pages, we organize your website around the information your customers are looking for.

Contact and Inquiry Features

We can add contact forms, call buttons, email links, maps, and other features that make it easier for potential customers to reach your business.

Social Media Integration

Connect your website with relevant social media profiles and business platforms.

Search-Friendly Foundation

We use a structured approach to help create a solid foundation for your future SEO strategy.

Website Maintenance Support

Need help after launch? We can assist with website updates, WordPress issues, maintenance, and other technical needs.

Business Website Design for Small and Growing Companies

You do not always need a large or overly complicated website to establish a strong online presence. For many businesses, a professionally built website with the right pages and clear information is exactly what customers need.

Our small business website design services can include pages such as:

  • Home page
  • About page
  • Service pages
  • Contact page
  • Gallery or portfolio
  • FAQ page
  • Inquiry or quote request page
  • Location and service area information
  • Blog setup, when needed

We help you determine which pages make sense for your business instead of adding unnecessary features that do not serve a clear purpose.

Whether you are launching a new company, moving your business online, or replacing an outdated website, we can help create a practical and professional solution.

Get in touch

  • (+1) 832 266 7209
  • info@fixwebsiteissues.com
  • Houston, Texas — serving all 50 states
Free Consultation

Why WevTEC

  • No deposit — pay after it's fixed
  • Pay only after the work is done
  • Complete backup before any change
  • No long-term contracts
Getting Started

Quick and hassle-free from the first call

Getting your WordPress website repaired is quick and hassle-free. Simply call us at 832-266-7209, or submit your contact information — and we’ll get back to you promptly.

Once we connect, we’ll schedule a live website review with you, either by phone, Zoom, or Google Meet (whichever works best). During this session, we’ll:

  • Review your website in real-time

  • Identify and explain the issues you’re facing

  • Provide a clear solution and expected timeline

  • Begin work immediately — after taking a full backup of your current website

We prioritize secure and transparent repairs, ensuring your website data and functionality are fully protected throughout the process. As a trusted USA-based website repair service, we understand how important your site is to your business — and we treat every repair with the urgency and care it deserves.

Speak to a Website Expert Now
FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions About Web Design

Still have questions?

Call or text us anytime — real experts, 24/7.

(832) 266 7209
How long does it take to design a business website?

The timeline depends on the number of pages, required features, content availability, and project complexity. A straightforward small business website may be completed relatively quickly once the requirements, content, and design direction are approved. Larger or custom web development projects can take longer.

How much do professional web design services cost?

Website design costs vary based on the size and requirements of the project. A simple small business website generally costs less than a large website with custom functionality, multiple pages, advanced forms, or additional development requirements. Contact us for a free consultation and project discussion.

Will my website work on mobile phones and tablets?

Yes. Our responsive website design approach focuses on making websites work across desktop computers, tablets, and mobile devices. We review layouts and important website functions before launch.

Can you redesign my existing website?

Yes. Our website redesign services can help update an outdated website, improve page layouts, reorganize navigation, and address usability or technical concerns. We can review your existing website and discuss whether a partial redesign or complete rebuild makes more sense.

Do you provide support after my website goes live?

Yes. We can provide ongoing assistance with website updates, WordPress maintenance, technical issues, content changes, and additional web development work after launch.

Need a New Website or a Website Redesign?

Sometimes an existing website simply needs improvements. Other times, starting with a new structure is the better option.

Our custom web design and website redesign services can help if your current website:

  • Looks outdated
  • Does not work well on mobile devices
  • Has confusing navigation
  • Contains broken or outdated pages
  • Is difficult to update
  • Does not clearly explain your services
  • Has technical or performance problems
  • No longer represents your current business

Before recommending a solution, we review your current situation and discuss what needs to change. Depending on the project, we may redesign selected pages, rebuild the entire website, or provide additional web development services to address technical problems.

Ready to Start Your Website?

Tell us what your business does, what you want your website to achieve, and whether you need a new design or a redesign. We will help you understand the next steps before the project begins.

From Your Idea to a Live Website

A successful business website starts with a clear plan. Our web design process is designed to keep the project organized, reduce unnecessary delays, and make sure the final website reflects your business.

1. Understand Your Business

We begin by learning about your business, services, customers, and website goals. We discuss the pages and features you need and review whether you are starting from scratch or replacing an existing website.

This planning stage helps us recommend the right structure for your business website design.

2. Plan the Website Structure

Next, we organize the main pages and navigation. For a typical small business website, this may include a homepage, service pages, an about page, and a contact page.

We focus on making important information easy for visitors to find.

3. Design the Website

Once the structure is clear, we begin building the visual layout. We use a clean, professional design that works with your business identity and keeps the user experience straightforward.

Our goal is not to overload your website with unnecessary effects. The design should support your content and make it easier for visitors to take action.

4. Develop the Website

After the design direction is established, we build the website and add the required pages, features, forms, images, and functionality.

For businesses that need an easy-to-manage platform, our WordPress web design services provide a practical option for managing website content and future updates.

5. Review and Test

Before launch, we review the website across different screen sizes and check important functionality, including navigation, contact forms, links, and page layouts.

We also look for issues that could affect the user experience.

6. Launch and Provide Support

Once the website is ready, we help with the launch process. If you need continued assistance, our team can also provide support for updates, maintenance, technical fixes, and future improvements.

What Type of Website Does Your Business Need?

Not every business needs the same type of website. The right solution depends on what you do, how customers find you, and what you need your website to accomplish.

We help businesses choose a practical website structure based on their actual requirements.

Small Business Website

A standard business website is a good option for companies that need to establish a professional online presence and clearly explain their services.

This type of website commonly includes:

  • Home page
  • About page
  • Service pages
  • Contact page
  • Inquiry form
  • Business information
  • Google Maps integration
  • Social media links

Service Business Website

Service providers need a website that clearly explains what they offer and gives potential customers a simple way to contact them.

We can create dedicated service pages, service area sections, quote forms, and clear calls to action.

WordPress Website

A WordPress website can be a good choice when you want flexibility and the ability to manage content after launch.

We build and configure websites while helping clients choose a structure that is practical for their business.

Website Redesign

If your existing website is outdated or no longer reflects your business, our website redesign services can improve the design, page structure, mobile experience, and overall usability.

We can also review existing content and technical issues as part of the project.

Custom Website

Some businesses require more specific functionality or a different website structure. Our custom web design and web development services can be adapted to your project requirements.

Included in Every Website Build

Every project is different, but our website design services focus on the core elements needed for a professional business website.

Responsive on All Devices

Your website should be easy to view and use whether someone visits from a computer, tablet, or smartphone.

Professional Page Layouts

We create clean layouts that organize your business information without making pages feel cluttered.

Clear Navigation

Visitors should not have to search for basic information. We structure menus and pages to help users find services, contact information, and other important details quickly.

Contact Features

Depending on your requirements, we can include:

  • Contact forms
  • Click-to-call buttons
  • Email links
  • Google Maps
  • Inquiry forms
  • Quote request forms

SEO-Friendly Website Structure

Our professional website design process considers website structure from the beginning. Organized pages, logical navigation, and properly planned content provide a better foundation for ongoing search optimization.

Support for Future Updates

Businesses change, and websites need updates. If you need help adding content, updating pages, fixing errors, or maintaining your website after launch, our team is available for continued support.

Website Design for New and Existing Businesses

Whether you are launching a business or already have an established company, your website should accurately represent where your business is today.

For a new business, we can help create the foundation for your online presence.

For an existing business, we can help update an old website that no longer meets your needs.

A redesign may be worth considering if your current website has:

  • An outdated appearance
  • Poor mobile usability
  • Difficult navigation
  • Old business information
  • Broken forms or pages
  • Slow or poorly functioning features
  • A design that no longer represents your brand
  • Difficulty supporting new services or content

As a website design company that also provides technical website support, we can look beyond appearance when reviewing your website. If there are underlying WordPress, plugin, theme, performance, or functionality issues, we can identify those concerns as part of the planning process.

Simple, Practical Website Solutions

We believe your website should be built around what your business actually needs.

Some businesses need a straightforward five-page website. Others need multiple service pages, location pages, blog functionality, or more advanced development work.

We discuss the scope before moving forward so you have a clearer understanding of the project.

Our team can help with:

  • New website design
  • Website redesign
  • WordPress website development
  • Responsive website design
  • Business website design
  • Landing pages
  • Service pages
  • Contact and inquiry forms
  • Website maintenance and updates
  • Technical website support

Have a Website Project in Mind?

Whether you need a new website, want to redesign an existing one, or are unsure what your business needs, start with a conversation. We can review your goals and discuss the right direction for your website.

Website Design Services Across the USA

FixWebsiteIssues.com provides web design services for businesses across the United States. Our team works with clients remotely and can discuss projects by phone, Zoom, or Google Meet.

Whether you need a new business website, a WordPress redesign, responsive pages, or ongoing website support, we focus on providing a clear process from planning through launch.

We help businesses that need:

  • A professional website for a new business
  • A redesign for an outdated website
  • Responsive website design for mobile users
  • WordPress web design and development
  • Additional service or location pages
  • Website maintenance and updates
  • Technical fixes after launch
  • Ongoing web development services

Our goal is to provide a practical website solution based on your business requirements without unnecessary complexity.

Ready to Build a Website That Works for Your Business?

Your website should give potential customers a clear understanding of who you are, what you offer, and how to contact you. Whether you are starting with a new idea or replacing an existing website, our team can help you plan the next step.

From professional website design and responsive development to WordPress support and website updates, we provide the technical assistance needed to get your website online and keep it working.
